entities.name: Ibn Khuzaymah

entities.summary: Muhammad ibn Ishaq ibn Khuzaymah al-Nishapuri was a prominent Persian Muslim muhaddith scholar and Shafi'i jurist. He is best known for his hadith collection, Sahih Ibn Khuzaymah.
